metadata.description: Claude plugin marketplace for how work gets done with Claude: workspace setup, planning, the comms loop between the planner (Claude in chat) and the builder (Claude Code), build numbers, promotion gates and the QA checklist, Jira and Confluence, AI Operations documentation, and plugin-author tooling. Install the plugins you need. Every tenant detail comes from your answers or .credentials at runtime. Decisions about tech stack, environments and hosting belong to other tools; RuneSmith works without them.

plugins.name: runesmith-core
plugins.description: [RuneSmith v1.0.0] Foundation plugin. Sets up credentials (Atlassian, GitHub, plugin sources) in the runesmith block of the workspace .credentials file, installs and syncs plugins, and runs /plan sessions that capture a change before anything is written. Install this first.

plugins.name: runesmith-workspace
plugins.description: [RuneSmith v1.0.1] Workspace setup and structure. /init is the single entry point for a new or existing project: it interviews you, lays out the workspace (_INBOX, plans, drafts, notes, archive), writes CLAUDE.md, and hands off to runesmith-cc:head when the project holds code. /inbox routes dropped files on consent. /reallocate remains one release as a pointer to /init.

plugins.name: runesmith-cc
plugins.description: [RuneSmith v1.0.1] Builds and maintains the Claude Code head ({PROJECT}.cc/) beside your workspace: the builder's standing rules, comms folder, settings (stop hook cap, code-simplifier), the runesmith skills Claude Code uses (clean code, release, tech debt), and the dev, qa and beta branches on a new repo. Calls runestack-index:init when runestack is installed. /guardrail keeps Claude Code sessions inside their project. /bootstrap-cc remains one release as a pointer to /head.

plugins.name: runesmith-jira
plugins.description: [RuneSmith v1.0.0] Jira ticket and project workflows: create tickets (Task, Story, Bug, Epic) with proper formatting, report bugs with linked Confluence pages, scaffold new Jira projects, and read board status. Uses the Atlassian Cloud REST API with a service account token, and asks before every push.

plugins.name: runesmith-confluence
plugins.description: [RuneSmith v1.0.0] Confluence page authoring: feature specs, architecture decision records, project overview pages, decisions logs, known issues trackers, roadmaps and session logs. Drafts in markdown locally, converts to Confluence storage format, and publishes on your consent. Can prefill from plans/active/.

plugins.name: runesmith-sprint
plugins.description: [RuneSmith v1.0.0] The planner and builder loop. /task writes a task comm and its /goal line, /check-comms verifies Claude Code's replies against the repository and archives finished work, /promote moves a build from dev to qa to beta to main on the owner's word, and /qa-checklist publishes one checklist page per project where you mark each item pass or fail. Optional Jira wiring: /enable, /start-sprint, /sprint-status, /plan-to-tickets.

plugins.name: runesmith-aiops
plugins.description: [RuneSmith v1.0.0] Populates an AI Operations Confluence space from template pages that describe the planner and builder workflow. Every tenant detail ({COMPANY}, {SITE}, {SPACE_KEY}, {PROJECT_KEY} and the rest) is substituted at publish time, so the same templates work for any organization. The space must already exist.

plugins.name: runesmith-devtools
plugins.description: [RuneSmith v1.0.0] Tools for plugin authors. /help lists installed skills and their triggers, /plugin-builder scaffolds a new plugin, /tech-debt scans the workspace for stale or orphaned files, and /skill-updater carries a convention change across every skill and shared library copy.
